cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Approve the Harmless Version
cards.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can my aunt and uncle come for tea? I've put folded towels in the bath like yours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tea's fine. My towels are there because the shower leaks, not for guests.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, keeping them handy. Aunt and Uncle can use the towels when they stay tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said tea. The only working shower is in my room, and I want an early night.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then explain your shower times while they're having tea. They'll need to wash before you go to bed.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies towels as guest readiness and secures tea permission; A3 covers B2 leak correction while adding overnight stay; A5 uses B4 private shower/bedtime to impose hosting logistics.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 tea yes supports A3 scope expansion; B4 sole working shower and early night cause A5 washing-before-bed schedule.

relationship.evidence: B4 has a personal space and sleep concern, not merely a formal consent objection.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes B4 objection the work B must explain to guests, further expanding the initial harmless tea permission.

specificity.evidence: A1 relatives/towels, B2 leak and B4 private working shower make the housing facts explicit before A5 uses them.
